contract: stage vocabulary keyed by the OPERATION each stage performs on the running cascade C_{k-1} -> C_k (resonances and nulls added or removed, and the dB change at each band edge), measured on a 2048-point log grid 40 Hz-16 kHz at the 39,062.5 Hz datum. Seats are the medoid geometry of each class.

transparent.structure: leaves the running cascade where it was: no resonance, no null, no shelf movement at either band edge

resonance.structure: adds a resonant peak and little else

resonance + guard zero.structure: adds a resonant peak with a companion null beside it — the chained pole/zero rung

resonance over low cut.structure: adds a resonant peak while removing level below 80 Hz: presence plus headroom, in one section

resonance over high cut.structure: adds a resonant peak while removing level above 12 kHz

null.structure: carves a null into the running cascade without adding a resonance

null relocation.structure: removes one null and opens another elsewhere

resonance removal.structure: cancels a resonance the earlier stages had built

low cut.structure: removes level below 80 Hz, no new resonance or null

low boost.structure: adds level below 80 Hz, no new resonance or null

high cut.structure: removes level above 12 kHz, no new resonance or null

high boost.structure: adds level above 12 kHz, no new resonance or null

broadband tilt.structure: moves both band edges in opposite directions without adding a resonance or a null

broadband level.structure: moves the whole response up or down together
